const r = await tools.mcp__lean_lsp__lean_run_code({code:`
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModels

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace TensorProduct
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry
noncomputable section
universe u

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]

@[reducible]
noncomputable instance testOverlapAlgebraLeftInst
    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    Algebra (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U)
      (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V) :=
  (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V).toRingHom.toAlgebra

noncomputable instance testOverlapScalarTowerLeft
    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    IsScalarTower k (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U)
      (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V) :=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r =>
    (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V).commutes r |>.symm

noncomputable instance testFinitePresentationOverlapLeft
    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    Algebra.FinitePresentation (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U)
      (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V) := by
  apply RingHom.finitePresentation_algebraMap.mp
  let f := pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V
  have hopen :
      IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom)) := by
    exact isOpenImmersion_pic0FiniteStageRestriction C (Sum.inl (U, V))
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom)) := hopen
  exact HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff.mp
    (show LocallyOfFinitePresentation
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom)) by infer_instance)

abbrev TestTripleRing (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :=
  (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V) ⊗[Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U]
    (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U W)

example (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    Algebra.FinitePresentation k (TestTripleRing C U V W) := by
  letI : Algebra.FinitePresentation (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V)
      (TestTripleRing C U V W) :=
    Algebra.FinitePresentation.baseChange (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V)
  exact Algebra.FinitePresentation.trans k
    (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V) (TestTripleRing C U V W)

end
end AlgebraicGeometry
`});
